writeup.key_factor: Highest win probability of the day and the biggest edge: 3-0 Lakers at home against a Portland side still building its new backcourt, without Shaedon Sharpe and with Scoot Henderson questionable.
writeup.risk: Lakers offensive numbers (128.0 points per game) are unsustainable and due for regression; Portland leads the league in early scoring on a tiny 2-game sample, and Henderson may still play. The 36-cent cushion above the -157 minimum absorbs a normal move, but a late Lakers scratch would change the picture and the pre-game check must confirm no new absence.

writeup.key_factor: Showcase Gold: strong home team (7-3-1, on a 5-game winning streak) against a weaker visiting side, at 1.88 decimal inside the 1.80-2.20 showcase band with the highest model probability in the band among eligible plays; projected goaltending favors Dallas (Oettinger .930 SV% vs Allen .886 SV%).
writeup.risk: The NHL Elo is the 2026-09-23 seed, not updated with the 2026-27 season in progress, so the edge leans on current form and goaltending rather than a fresh rating; Oettinger is projected, not team-confirmed, and New Jersey is a solid 7-4-0 side. The pre-game check must confirm Oettinger still starts.
